messages:
maria: Heads up — telemetry for the last 30m shows a big jump in 429s on public keys that just hit their burst window after the precheck change. Anyone else seeing this?
ken: Yep, saw it. Pattern: short spike, then clients hammer with retries and we end up with sustained queue depth.
sophia: To be clear, the precheck currently does per-key token accounting first, then a per-org precheck. We moved the per-key check to the edge to stop wasted routing. That reduced wasted cycles but made 429s more likely when org-level capacity is exhausted.
tim_ops: Ops prefers 503 when the runtime is overloaded — it signals a system problem and lets our circuit-breakers kick in. Many SDKs treat 429 as a user-rate problem and retry faster.
maria: Right, that's the crux. We want client-side retries for legitimate per-key bursts, but we also need slower backoff for system overload.
ken: Proposal: split responses — return 429 with header `X-Quota-Reason: key-burst` for per-key throttles, and 503 + `X-Quota-Reason: org-overload` for when the org-level queue is saturated and shedding is necessary. That gives clients a signal to apply different retry policies.
sophia: Implementation detail: we already have a `precheck_reason` enum. We can map to HTTP codes at the edge layer. Need to ensure we never leak split semantics for Dedicated customers who want strict 429-only behavior (SLA/legal).
tim_ops: Also add `Retry-After` when we can predict cooldown (burst credit expires in Xs). For org-overload 503s we should include `Retry-After: 10` and a `x-suggested-backoff: exponential` header? Might be overkill.
infra-bot: deploy: quota-edge-v2 rolled to canary in prod region-1 at 2026-03-02T15:03:02Z — 3/10 hosts.
maria: Good to know. Let's add dashboard panels: split count of 429:key-burst vs 503:org-overload, and median client retry interval. We should also flag top 10 keys causing immediate replays.
ken: I worry about clients that don't honor `Retry-After`. Could we soften immediate 429s by granting tiny grace tokens at edge (e.g., 5 extra tokens as short burst credit) for keys with good history? That reduces noisy retries.
sophia: We already have burst credits, but they live in the central quota store. We can implement a small local-edge fast-path cache for credits (TTL 2s) for well-behaved keys. Complexity: consistency and accounting.
tim_ops: Operationally we need alerts: sharp rise in 503s, <p95 latency spike, and queue-length > 80% capacity for 30s. Also an automated rollback if errors spike post-rollout.
maria: Action items: (1) sophia to prototype edge mapping of precheck_reason -> status code + headers (PR by EOD Fri) (2) ken to add dashboard panels and alerts (3) tim_ops to propose retry header schema + ops playbook. I'll draft RFC for the behavioral contract with SDK teams.
ken: I'll also add a short note in the console rollout UX: when users toggle org-burst-capacity it should show expected client behavior (429 vs 503) so SREs aren't surprised.
sophia: One more: test matrix — per-key burst, org-saturated, dedicated-customer mode. Need e2e that asserts correct code and headers.
maria: Cool. If no objections, proceed. :thumbsup:
ken: +1
tim_ops: +1 :shipit:
infra-bot: incident-watch: alert rule `quota-org-overload` created (id: qoo-2026-031), eval window 30s.
